gripOrHq.title: Promises, Promises
gripOrHq.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, score 1 additional agenda point.

gripOrHq.title: All-Hands
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, access three additional cards from HQ. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Rush Hour
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Networking
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

gripOrHq.title: R&D Mole
gripOrHq.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: R&D Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
